descriptionByLocale.it: I tuoi compiti - Avrai una visione variegata della professione in 2 giorni. - Sei autorizzato a partecipare attivamente. - Impari a conoscere l'azienda. Your tasks - You will get a varied insight into the profession over 2 days. - You are allowed to actively participate. - You get to know the company.
• What you bring to the table - You are interested in getting to know the teaching profession. - You are curious and ask questions.
• What we offer you - Annual subscription "update Fitness" - CHF 500 for laptop or tablet - 50% off first mobile plan from Coop Mobile - SBB Half-Fare travelcard or GA share CHF 650 - Many discounts for employees Lea Hädinger HR Vocational Education and Training Choose Your Character: Create Your Future Shape your future with a suitable apprenticeship. Coop offers a wide range of apprenticeships and further training opportunities.
